name: pageink-embed
description: PageInk as one script any site can add to its own pages, with a pluggable store.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build -c vite.iife.config.ts && node scripts/types.mjs && node scripts/sizes.mjs
scripts.test: vite build && vite build -c vite.iife.config.ts && node scripts/types.mjs && node ../../scripts/run-all.mjs "vitest run --project unit" "vitest run --project browser --browser.name=chromium" "vitest run --project browser --browser.name=webkit" "vitest run --project browser --browser.name=firefox"
